prompt:
A desktop website home page, rendered edge to edge at 16:9 with crisp readable text, no browser window, device or desk around it. It is the portfolio of Giannia, an architecture student; architecture firms and admissions committees come to scan her work and open a project.

The page is an open dot-grid sketchbook seen flat from above, two warm off-white pages meeting at a soft centre gutter. Ink is near-black fineliner; small strips of muted sage and sand washi tape; the paper fills the whole screen.

What leads: her works as white-bordered die-cut stickers scattered across both pages at slight angles, each a crisp architectural image: a floor plan, a white chipboard model photo, a perspective render of a bathhouse, a pencil site sketch, the first page of an essay titled "On Thresholds". Under each sticker a short handwritten caption: project name, year, type. Some stickers held by a strip of washi tape.

Frame: top left of the left page, "Giannia" handwritten large with "architecture student · works & words" beneath; filters as coloured tabbed page edges sticking out from the right side of the book: Projects, Models, Sketches, Writing, Competitions; top right small "About" and "Contact"; bottom corner page number "p. 01".
